title: Whitney's C¹ extension theorem on ℝⁿ (Simon Ch. 2, Theorem 1.6), value part
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n). Let A ⊆ ℝⁿ be closed, h : ℝⁿ → ℝ continuous on A, and D : ℝⁿ → L(ℝⁿ, ℝ) continuous on A. Suppose that for every compact Q ⊆ A and every τ > 0 there is ρ > 0 such that |h(y) − h(x) − D(x)(y − x)| ≤ τ|y − x| for all x ∈ Q and y ∈ A with |x − y| < ρ. Then there is g : ℝⁿ → ℝ of class C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1 g) with g = h on A.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Rn n)) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (D : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] ℝ)), IsClosed A → ContinuousOn h A → ContinuousOn D A → (∀ Q : Set (Rn n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ A → ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Q, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < ρ → ‖h y - h x - D x (y - x)‖ ≤ τ * ‖y - x‖) → ∃ g : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ ∀ a ∈ A, g a = h a
